OPC Compliance Test Tool
OPC Data Access 2.05a Compliance Test Service Release 22

February 23, 2012

"CTT Data Access 2.05a Module" Product Version 2.0.22.1168

This file contains information on latest changes general usage and known bugs of the Compliance Test Tool. Read carefully before using the Compliance Test Tool.

Support

Support and useful information on issues regarding the OPC Compliance Test Tool can be found in:
  • this read me file,
  • the online help file installed with this product,
  • the test case description provided for every single test case,
  • the OPC forum on the OPC website (OPC Forum) ,
  • the FAQ and FAQ-archive on the OPC website (FAQ Data Access).

Setup

For a successful installation procedure please notice the following information.
  • All previous Versions 2.x of the Compliance Test Tool (CTT) must be uninstalled before installing the new CTT.
  • All previous versions 1.x can remain installed and can "exist" parallel on the same system. However, they can not be "executed" at the same time!
  • You must have administrative rights on the machine to execute the setup.
  • At least Microsoft Data Access Components (MDAC) Version >= 2.6 must be installed on the target machine before installing the CTT Modules.
  • Separate (individual) setups for every Compliance Test Tool Module are available:
    1. CTT Common Modules
    2. CTT Data Access 2.05a Module
    3. CTT Alarm and Events 1.1 Module
    4. CTT Data Access 3.0 Module
    5. CTT XML Data Access 1.01 Module
    6. CTT Historical Data Access 1.2 Module
  • The "CTT Common Modules" must be installed first and at least one additional Testing Module must be installed.
  • All Setup projects are generated using the installer package included in .NET Studio 2003. The outcome is a self installing packed MSI-file containing the setup. Especially on Windows NT machines the Microsoft Installer (MSI) must be installed, the MSI Installer V2.0 itself is not included in the CTT setup files, but can be downloaded on Microsoft website (InstMsiW.Exe).
  • Only for the "CTT Common Modules" the destination path can be selected. All other modules automatically detect the target directory and install into the correct path.
  • Only for the "CTT Common Modules" the user must select between "Everyone" and "Just me" to assign persons using the CTT.

OPC Data Access 2.05a

WARNING: This Tool was designed to run in a laboratory environment. The test should not be run on an OPC Server that is connected to a real process. The Test Client writes randomly generated values to the OPC Server, thus it can cause damages when accessing real process/production data.

Version Information:
  • Setup File Name:
    OPC CTT DataAccess2 Modules 2.00.22.msi
  • Compliance Test Component:
    Version 2.0.22.1168
  • Testing against Data Access 2 Custom Specification:
    Version 2.05A from June 28, 2002
  • Tested with Sample Server:
    OPCSample.OpcDaServer
    OPC DA 3.00 Sample Binaries 3.00.105.1.msi
    February 23, 2012
Previous Test Version: V 2.0.21.1167

Previous Release Version: V 2.0.21.1162

General Information:
  • The OPC Compliance Test Tool software is a test client that should help developers to chase and find errors and improper behavior of their OPC Servers.
  • The Test Client is also used to run the OPC Compliance Test (Self Certification). The results of a successful compliance test run can be posted to the OPC Foundation and will be published on the OPC website.
  • At least two items must be selected to run a test procedure, but in the compliance result all test cases will be listed that could not be executed because of missing data types or missing access rights. So, be a good citizen and select items of each data type and each access right for a compliance test run.
  • For the test run i.e. "LogicalTest", so called "static" items are required. Static items are items that are only changed by the client and not by the server. These items are used for write- and read-back- tests and should not be changed (generated) by the server.
  • The results of certain test runs are stored in an encrypted database file. Even if you try to open this file it gets corrupted and you are forced to reinstall the CTT Module.
Changes:
  • IOPCSyncIO::Read
    Apply the configured wait time between adding an item and the first read from cache for that item. The wait time was not applied in all cases.
  • IOPCServer::RemoveGroup - Case 4
    Release reference to the group after removing the group.
  • IOPCServer::RemoveGroup - Case 6
    Only release own reference to the group. Add some more detailed trace output.
  • LogicalTest - AddItems>
    Allow AddItems to return the canonical datatype VT_EMPTY.
  • IOPCBrowseServerAddressSpace::BrowseOPCItemIDs>
    Allow the server to return OPC_E_INVALIDFILTER if the server supports filter that work different than VB LIKE operator.
Known Bugs:
  • At creation time of this file there were no known bugs in the "CTT Data Access 2.05a Module" of the OPC Compliance Test Tool.
  • The OPC forum is an addition to the OPC website to provide advanced services to OPC members and developers. If you discover any errors caused using this CTT please report to OPC forum on the OPC Foundation website (OPC Forum).
Limitations:
  • The item browser is using ValidateItems to determine the canonical DataType of the test items. Thus if ValidateItems returns VT_EMPTY the DataType will not be correct. This can cause problems in some of the logical tests. In this case the items must be added manually with the correct DataType.

History of "CTT Data Access 2.05a Module":

Changes in Version 2.0.22.1168:
  • OPC Groups
    The OPC groups used for several tests don't set deadband anymore. This allows servers to pass if they do not support deadband.
  • OPC Groups
    Whenever adding a group with deadband other than 0.0 allow OPC_E_DEADBANDNOTSUPPORTED.
Changes in Version 2.0.20.1156:
  • LogicalTest - CheckRangeBehaviourSyncWrite
    Generate warning instead of failure when server returns E_FAIL instead of expected error (E_RANGE).
  • SyncIO::Write - all test cases
    A missing check in a method getting the HighEU and LowEU properties caused the CTT not to show an error if the HighEU and LowEU is outside the range of the datatype the item has.
  • CheckUpdateRate - Case8
    For the initial OnDataChange allow both qualities: OPC_QUALITY_NOT_CONNECTED and OPC_QUALITY_WAITING_FOR_INITIAL_DATA.
  • IOPCCommon::SetLocalID and GetLocalID
    Allow server to return error when setting localID to LOCAL_SYSTEM_DEFAULT.
  • IOPCItemMgt::AddItems/ValidateItems - Case 14
    Microsoft has change the behaviour of the proxy/stub since Vista. On XP the proxy/stub returned the erorr code 0xc0000005, on Vista hte proxy/stub throws an exception.
  • LogicalTest - CheckUpdateRate Case 1-8
    Don't evaluate the time between the initial and the second datachange.
  • IOPCGroupStateMgt::SetState - Case 18
    Changed the test to ignore the timing for the first datachange for each UDR.
  • General utility method
    Internal RemoveSpecificGroup method had a bug not setting the created-flag.
  • IOPCServerPublicGroup::RemovePublicGroup - Case 5
    Allow all failed results now.
Changes in Version 2.0.19.1152:
  • IOPCGroupStateMgt::SetState - Case 18
    Changed order of calls. First setting new UpdateRate via SetState and then writing new values now.
  • CheckUpdateRate - Case 8
    If the server returned an initial datachange with quality bad the CTT wasn't waiting long enough for the next datachange with good quality.
  • IOPCServerPublicGroups::RemovePublicGroup - all tests
    A bug caused the server to fail the test if the server returned OPC_S_UNSUPPORTEDRATE when adding the group during the test preparation.
  • IOPCBrowseServerAddressSpace::BrowseOPCItemIDs - all tests
    Most of the browse tests browse recursivly through the servers address space. For big configurations this produced a lot of output in the CTT GUI and the log files and slowed the test down. Reduced the output for all browse tests - mainly displaying warnings and errors now.
  • LogicalTest::CheckUpdateRate - Case 3
    Not using items of datatype bool for this test anymore. Also changed logic how values for writing are generated.
  • IOPCSyncIO::Read - Case 11
    Fixed error in check for quality. Quality bits were not masked correctly.
  • LogicalTest::CompareDataTypes
    The test didn't wait for another datachange if the initial datachange returned items with quality OPC_QUALITY_NOT_CONNECTED or OPC_QUALITY_WAITING_FOR_INITIAL_DATA.
  • IOPCAsyncIO2::Refresh2 - all tests
    Revised all Refresh2 tests: Added checks for correct TransactionID, added logic to detect unexpected datachanges, improved output for user information if tests fail.
  • Wait time between AddItems and first read in test settings
    In the test settings there is an option to configure the time the CTT has to wait between AddItems and Read from cache. This is the time the server needs to initially fill the cache so a value and a good quality is returned when reading. That wait time wasn't applied in all tests where it should be. Revised all SyncIO tests.
  • CheckUpdateRate - Case 8
    An error in the logic for changing the values that are written could cause the server to fail if analog items with EuLow and EUHigh were configured for this test. Changed method that generates the values.
  • CheckDataTypes::AddItemsWithAllDataTypes
    Fixed error that caused the CTT to request properties for invalid ItemIDs. Added some comments for user information if test fails. Generating error now if read during the test case preparation fails, returns bad quality or no value.
Changes in Version 2.0.18.1149:
  • Test Settings - Restricted characters in ItemIDs
    The CTT could not handle itemIDs containing '=' or starting with '['. The test is now using URL encoded strings for saving and loading configuration data.
  • LogicalTest - CheckUpdateRate - Case 1-8
    The test did not expect an initial DataChange containing items with quality BAD_NOT_CONNECTED. If items have that quality the test now waits for another DataChange.
  • LogicalTest - CheckUpdateRate - Case 8
    The test does not fail anymore if the server returns no DataChange within the first update period. A warning is generated instead.
  • Performance Test - ASyncRead
    The configured time waiting for data callbacks was not set correctly. Now the timeout set in the test settings is used for this test.
  • GetItemProperties - Case 1
    Missing check could cause the test conponent to crash if server returned an empty variant (VT_EMPTY) as property value.
  • BrowseOPCItemIDs - Case 10 and 11
    In the CTT the filter criteria was checked case sensitive. Some servers have the filter implemented case insensitive. As the description in the specification is not accurate at this point the CTT allows both now, case insensitive and case sensitive filtering
  • AddItems and ValidateItems - Case 14
    On Windows XP/2000 machines the proxy / stub returned an error for the AddItems() call. On Vista systems the proxy / stub throws an exception. The test didn't expect an exception here and generated a misleading output.
Changes in Version 2.0.17.1146:
  • StressTest Read/Write
    In this test the written values are compared with values read back. For DateTime types a warning was generated if the values were not exactly the same. The compare now takes care of the precision.
Changes in Version 2.0.16.1145:
  • AddItems->Case 14
    On Windows Vista the Proxy/Stub throws an exception when passing the invalid parameter for dwCount. Thus the test failed on Vista Systems. Changed check in test and accept the exception if the server is not running inproc.
  • ValidateItems->Case 14
    On Windows Vista the Proxy/Stub throws an exception when passing the invalid parameter for dwCount. Thus the test failed on Vista Systems. Changed check in test and accept the exception if the server is not running inproc.
  • IOPCServer->GetStatus
    Generate a warning if no Vendor info is returned. The vendor info is required for the generation of the compliance report.
  • Logical Test::Check UpdateRate->Case8
    Timer was not initialised if the first DataChange did not arrive. That caused an error in the test case cleanup.
  • Logical Test::Check UpdateRate->Case8
    Changed test to used only items of type numeric or string.
  • Logical Test::Check UpdateRate->Case8
    A race condition in the write loop of this test caused some servers to fail casually.
  • IOPCItemProperties::QueryAvailableProperties->Case 1
    Added missing check for out parameter szDescription.
  • IOPCItemProperties::QueryAvailableProperties->Case 3
    Allow return value E_FAIL.
  • IOPCItemProperties::LookupItemIDs->Case 3
    Allow return value E_FAIL.
  • LogicalTest::CheckReadErrors->SyncRead and AsyncRead
    Generate a warning if return value is OPC_E_RANGE or DISP_E_OVERFLOW instead of failing the test.
  • IOPCServer::AddGroup->Case 18
    A warning generated in this test was not delegated up in the tree view. Thus it was difficult to see where the warning came from.
  • TestSettings
    A server can now be run as inproc and outproc even if they have the same progID.
Changes in Version 2.0.15.1138:
  • Test Settings
    When adding items manually it is now also possible to choose array types.
  • IOPCItemMgt::AddItems and ValidateItems
    The tests now do accept the server to return VT_EMPTY as canonical datatype when adding/validating items.
  • Logical Test->CheckDataChange->CheckUpdateRate->Case 8
    To avoid timing problems the CTT measures the fastest UpdateRate the server supports before starting the test. The Test is using only one item now.
  • PerformanceTest::AsyncRead and AsyncWrite
    Improved the time measurement for the async interfaces.
  • IOPCBrowseServerAddressSpace::BrowseOPCItemIDs::Case 10 and 11
    If an item name starts with a special character that has a special meaning in the filter string (e.g. #, *, ?) the test failed. Now the characters used in the filter string are masked.
  • IOPCGroupStateMgt::SetState::Case 18
    Instead of using a predefined updaterate for the test the CTT now deternimes the fastest updaterate the server supports. When the datachange takes more time than expected the test does not fail now but a warning is generated.
  • IOPCGroupStateMgt::SetState::Case 18
    This test case writes new values to all items and compares the number of items in the OnDataChange with the number expected. There was a bug in the CTT writing the same values again to items of the canonical DataType VT_ARRAY | VT_BOOL. That caused servers to fail the test because the comparison of the number of items failed.
  • IOPCGroupStateMgt::SetState::Case 18
    The test now runs with one item only to avoid timing problems. Before starting the test, the fastest UpdateRate the server supports is measured. This rate is used for the calculation of the UpdateRates used in the test.
  • Test Settings => General => Number of test runs
    The up-down buttons next to the text boxes for setting the number of test runs and parallel runs were missing. Now it's possible to change the numbers and to run multiple tests.
  • IOPCAsyncIO2::Read::Cases 8 and 9
    The quality was not checked here. The test will fail now if bad quality is returned in the OnReadComplete callback.
  • New test case: IOPCSyncIO::Write::Case 13
    New test case for writing multiple tags, reading back the values and verifying the write by comparing the values.
  • New test case: IOPCAsyncIO2::Write::Case 14
    New test case for writing multiple tags, reading back the values and verifying the write by comparing the values.
  • New Test Cases: Logical Test->Check Read Errors->SyncRead and AsyncRead
    Add item of canonical dataType VT_BSTR, write non numeric string (e.g. "Hello"), set requested DataType to a numeric type (e.g. VT_I2). A read or refresh must fail with E_BADTYPE, E_FAIL or a VariantChangeType error code.
  • New Test Case: Logical Test->CheckDataChange->CheckUpdateRate->Case 8
    Add different groups with different UpdateRates and the same items. Write to all items with a fast rate and check if all groups report OnDataChange in the right rate.
  • New Test Case: Logical Test->CheckDataChange->CheckActivateGroups
    Add 2 groups, one is active one is inactive. Write to items in the inactive group and receive OnDataChanges in the active group.
  • IOPCServer::AddGroup::Case 18
    If running remotely the timeBias is not necessarily the same as on the local machine. When running the CTT remotely this test is skipped and a warning is generated.
  • New Test Case: IOPCAsyncIO2::Refresh2::Case 5
    Call Refresh on an active group containing inactive items only. Refresh is expected to return E_FAIL and no OnDataChange callback must be sent.
  • New Test Case: IOPCAsyncIO2::Refresh2::Case 6
    Call Refresh on an inactive group containing active items. Refresh is expected to return E_FAIL and no OnDataChange callback must be sent.
  • New Test Case: IOPCAsyncIO2::Refresh2::Case 7
    Call Refresh on an active group containing no item. Refresh is expected to return E_FAIL and no OnDataChange callback must be sent.
  • New Test Case: IOPCBrowseServerAddressSpace::GetItemID::Case6
    Browse to a branch with at least one leaf. Calling GetItemID with an empty string must return the ItemID of the current branch.
  • IOPCBrowseServerAddressSpace::GetItemID
    All ItemsIDs returned from a GetItemID call are now checked for null strings and are verified with a ValidateItems call.
  • Logical Test->CheckDataTypes->CheckRangeBehaviourSyncRead and AsyncRead
    If a range error is returned for an item the quality in OPCITEMSTATE must be bad. Added check for this.
  • Registering the callback interface failed for some servers
    A CoInitializeSecurity call was added to avoid problems registering the callback interface when running the CTT remotely.
  • Logical Test->CheckDataTypes->CheckRangeBehaviourAsyncRead
    Improved output if test case fails to help the user find the error.
  • IOPCGroupeStateMgt::SetState::Case18
    For some configurations it was possible that this test failed because the CTT wrote to some items the same values that the items already had. This of course did not cause the expected DataChange. The test now ensures that the values that are written to provoke a DataChange differ from the old values. Further the test checks if read-writeable items are available before starting this case.
Changes in Version 2.0.13.1134:
  • IOPCGroupStateMgt::SetState::Case4
    When calling IOPCGroupStateMgt::SetState with updateRate = 0 the CTT expected S_UNSUPPORTEDRATE.
    The CTT does not set a Warning anymore if SetState returns S_OK and revisedUpdateRate = 0.
  • IOPCItemMgt::AddItems::Case16
    CTT now checks if the number of items in a group matches the number of items which succeeded the AddItems call. This is checked by calling IOPCItemMgt::CreateEnumerator.
    The same check is added to LogicalTest -> CheckDataTypes -> AddItemsWithAllDataTypes.
  • IOPCGroupeStateMgt::SetState::Case18
    For some configurations it was possible that this test failed because the CTT wrote to some items the same values that the items already had. This of course did not cause the expected DataChange.
    The test now ensures that the values that are written to provoke a DataChange differ from the old values. Further the test checks if read-writeable items are available before starting this case.
  • LogicalTest::CheckDataTypes::CompareDataTypes
    This test caused an error if no read-writeable items were configured.
    Now there is a check at the beginning of the test, skipping the test if no read-writeable items are configured.
  • IOPCGroupeStateMgt::SetState::Case18
    When writing new values to multiple items the server is free to send one or more DataChanges.
    The test did not expect that multiple dataChanges arrive after one write operation.
Changes in Version 2.0.12.1132:
  • Bug in VariantChangeType
    When converting floating point values to integer values the rounding done by variantchangetype does not conform with the opc spec. The values used in the test were changed to avoid this problem.
  • IOPCItemMgt::CreateEnumerator::Case1
    Added checks for IOPCItemMgt::CreateEnumerator::Case1 to check the returned item count compared to the number of items in the group.
  • New Logical Test::CheckDataTypes::CompareDataTypes
    Test to check if for each configured item the same DataType is returned for each call. Calling IOPCSyncIO::Read, IOPCAsyncIO2::Read, GetItemProperties and provoking an OnDataChanged event. The returned DataTypes are then compared to be the same.
  • New Test IOPCGroupStateMgt::SetState Case 18
    The SetState function is called with different UpdateRates. The CTT checks if the OnDataChange callbacks arrive accordant to the new UpdateRate. The DataChanges are provoked by writing different values to the items. At the end of the test case the same values are written twice expecting only one DataChange.
Changes in Version 2.0.11.1130:
  • OPCServer::IOPCItemProperties::QueryAvailableProperties case 5
    The test case has a dependency to the optional interface IOPCBrowserServerAddressSpace and failed if the optional interface is not available or the server has no branches. This problem is fixed. The result of the test case will be SKIPPED if the optional browse interface is not available.
  • Rounding problems with floating point data types
    Several test cases in the DA Compliance Test are comparing data from Write calls and from Read or DataChange calls. The VARIANT comparison with equal values failed for servers which are not storing the data as VARIANT internally. We changed the comparison of floating point values from variant compare method to a special check that uses a precision of 7 for VT_R4 and 15 for VT_R8.
  • Check of client item handles in OnDataChange
    We noticed during the last US IOP workshop that not all test cases check for valid client item handles in the OnDataChange calls or the other callbacks. We added some general checks to validate the item client handles in all callback methods.
  • Stress Test::Read/Write
    The stress test count the number of OnDataChange call-backs and prints an warning if the server sent more OnDataChanges than expected. But the test had no special handling for OnDataChange call-backs with quality BAD items which requires an additional OnDataChange with the quality GOOD. The test has now a special handling for the OnDataChange call-backs with quality BAD.
  • Logical Test::CheckDataTypes::CheckRangeBehaviorXXX
    The specification requires not only to return OPC_E_RANGE in the case of an range error. The quality of the returned OPCITEMSTATE must be also initialized with quality bad. We added additional checks to validate this behavior.
  • Logical Test::CheckDataChange::CheckUpdateRate
    The test cases for CheckUpdateRate expected a update rate of 1000 ms like requested. This caused the test cases to fail if the server set another update rate than requested. The test uses now the RevisedUpdateRate as base for the OnDataChange checks in the test cases.
  • Stress test for servers on small devices
    The stress test uses 10 server connections with 10 groups per connections and 10 items per group. These settings could not be changed for the Compliance Test run. These settings should be no problem for PC based OPC Servers but caused problems for OPC Servers running on smaller devices. For this reason the numbers could now be configured also for the Compliance Test run but will be indicated as WARNINGS in the final test result for the OPC Foundation web site.
Changes in Version 2.0.10.1128:
  • Stress Test uses Inproc and Outproc server
    The stress test used different settings for CoCreateInstance than in the rest of the test if the tested server is registered as inproc and outproc server with the same ProgID. The test is using now the same settings for all CoCreateInstance calls during the test.
  • LogicalTest->CheckDataTypes->CheckValueConversionAsyncRead
    The test cases in CheckValueConversionAsyncRead did not accept the result OPC_S_CLAMP but it is allowed in all other test cases of the logical test. We changed the affected test case since all other test cases do also accept OPC_S_CLAMP.
  • Remote connect to tested OPC server
    The test tries to browse the remote registry for testing. The test failed if this remote browsing failed for some keys. Such an error will not longer fail the test since the remote browsing could fail for several reasons also if the server is registered in the right way on the remote computer.
Changes in Version 2.0.9.1124:
  • Compliance Test output
    The output format for the Compliance Test result was changed to a XML format. This new result file can be uploaded directly to the product web site of the tested product.
  • Stress Test::Read/Write::Case5
    Conversions of VT_DATE values to other types than VT_DATE in the server could cause different VARINAT values between write and read. The Compliance Test accepts now differences smaller than 1 ms without a warning.
  • Performance Test::SyncRead
    The test case executes the set of performance measurements now also for a read from device.
  • OPCGroup::AsyncIO2::Refresh2::case 4
    Servers with slow connection to the device caused problems during the preparation of the test case. Initial OnDataChange callbacks after AddItems caused failed results in the test case. The test case has now a waiting loop for initial OnDataChange callbacks after AddItems
  • OPCGroup::AsyncIO2::Write::case 13
    Servers with slow connection to the device caused problems in the following test case if not all write calls could be executed in the wait time. The test case calls now cancel for all outstanding transactions to avoid problems in the following test cases.
  • OPCServer::IOPCServer::AddGroup
    All test cases that used AddGroup with a deadband != 0.0 failed if a server returned OPC_E_DEADBANDNOTSUPPORTED. This return code is allowed. All affected test cases are changed to accept this error code and to repeat the test with deadband = 0.0
  • Logical Test::CheckDataChange::CheckUpdateRate
    The test cases to check the UpdateRate between OnDataChange callbacks faild for some servers since there was no message loop between the last write call and the analysis of the OnDataChanges. Adding a message loop after the last write call fixed the problem.
Changes in Version 2.0.8.1120:
  • Access Violation when testing Inproc-Servers
    There was a problem with the reference count in the Performance Test of the CTT. This error caused an Access Violation in the test client at the end of the test if the tested server was an inproc server. The test finished successfully if the server was an outproc server. This problem is fixed.
  • IOPCItemProperties::QueryAvailableProperties Case 3
    The test case expects one of the error codes 0x800706F4 (error from proxy/stub), E_INVALIDARG or E_POINTER because passing a NULL pointer instead of a pointer to a string is an invalid argument or even more precisely an invalid pointer. Now OPC_E_INVALIDITEMID was added to the list of accepted return codes because it gives a hint to the right parameter, however, E_POINTER should be preferred.
  • IOPCItemMgt::AddItems Case 3 checking Blob
    The test case checked the pointers to the Blob instead of checking the content of the Blob. However, even comparing the content makes no sense, as the server can update the Blob for an item at any time entirely at the server’s discretion. Checking the Blob was completely removed from this test case.
  • Logical Test::CheckRangeBehaviorAsyncWrite
    The test case did not reset the flag that indicates an incoming callback before the next write was executed. Caused by that the CTT mixed up the incoming callbacks. This problem is fixed now.
  • Logical Test::CheckDataTypes::ASyncReadWithAllDatatypes using array of string
    The test case accepted the error codes OPC_E_BADTYPE and DISP_E_TYPEMISMATCH only for the data type VT_BSTR but not for VT_ARRAY | VT_BSTR. This problem is fixed now.
  • Logical Test::CheckDataTypes::ChackRangeBehaviourSyncWrite (and AsyncWrite) having no RW items
    The test case generated a failure when a server contains NO read/write items at all (only R and W items). This problem is fixed now and the test case now checks the availability of RW items before executing the test.
  • Logical Test::CheckWriteErrors using VT_U8 and array of longlong
    As the old MS Studio 6 (thus the CTT also) does not support LongLong data types the selection of test items is now limited to 12 major data types (and their array types). The test settings dialog was changed to avoid selection of data types that are not supported by the CTT.
  • Stress Test fails when using items of type string
    If not enough items are selected for the Stress Test the CTT duplicates existing items. When using same string item several times within the same test group, the Stress Test failed occasionally. This problem is fixed now.
  • Stress Test::Read/Write Case 5 generates warning
    The Test Case writes 2 different values to the same item but expects the written value in the OnDataChanges. Test will no longer generate random values for strings. They are now also incremented like the other types. This problem is fixed now.
  • TestSettings Dialog: setting AccessRights
    When adding items "manually" to the test items list, the AccessRights could not be set. This problem is fixed.
Changes in Version 2.0.7.1116:
  • Performance Test::Add/Remove Items:
    Some very fast servers had problems passing this test because the "time based" measurement and the "function call based" measurement interfered. This problem is fixed.
  • Initial value for VT_DATE items:
    Test items having VT_DATA data type were set to very small initial values by the CTT. These "early" dates caused problems in some servers. The initial value is set to the current date and time ("NOW") to overcome this problem.
  • LogicalTest::CheckDataChange::CheckUpdateRate:
    The CTT writes always the same values, but expected DataChanges to occur. The values are not incremented if the properties EULow and EUHigh have the same value. If the high and low EU-limits are equal, the CTT ignores their values. This problem is fixed.
  • TestSettings Dialog:
    When switching back from "Test1" to "NewTest" within the combo the "Reset All"-button is enabled and after pressing it the ProgID disappeared. The dialog did not show Items for ItemProperties after reloading a file. Both problems are fixed.
Changes in Version 2.0.6.1114:
  • Stress Test::Read/Write:
    The test case fails with some servers because previous changes made the test cases more timing dependent. The handling of the DataChanges is now revised
  • Release of group interfaces in OPGGroup Object test:
    The test didn't release all group interfaces in the OPCGroup object test. This problem is fixed.
Changes in Version 2.0.5.1112:
  • IOPCAsyncIO2::Read::Case4:
    Test case fails in some conditions if the server returns the expected errors as late errors in the callback. This problem is fixed.
  • Consistency check after Compliance Test run fails:
    The consistency check after the Compliance Test fails if the server supports IOPCServerPublicGroup. This problem is fixed.
  • Problems with large Strings > 1000 characters:
    Large strings with more than 1000 characters caused problems in the output functionality of the CTT. This problem is fixed.
  • IOPCAsyncIO2 - OnDataChange with write only items
    The check in IOPCDataCallback::OnDataChange failed if there are write only items included in the test and the server sent the error OPC_E_BADRIGHTS in the OnDataChange for these items. The CTT checks now if the items are write only.
  • IOPCAsyncIO2 - display of ItemIDs in callbacks
    The output of the CTT in the callback methods displayed the passed parameters with the wrong ItemID if the servers used a different sort order than in the AddItems. This problem is fixed.
  • IOPCItemMgt::ValidateItems::Case5 and Case7:
    These two test cases didn't use the invalid ItemID from the test settings. This problem is fixed.
  • LogicalTest::CheckDataChange::CheckRefresh:
    An unexpected OnDataChange at the end of the test case can cause an Access Violation in the OnDataChange method. This problem is fixed.
Changes in Version 2.0.4.1110:
  • IOPCSyncIO::Read::Case28:
    There was a wrong memory access in some special conditions which causes the test to fail. This problem is fixed now.
  • LookUpItemIDs::Case9:
    Only for the PropertyIDs "7" and "8" the return code OPC_E_INVALID_PID will be accepted in addition to E_FAIL. However, for all PropertyIDs larger than "8" the server is expected to return E_FAIL.
Changes in Version 2.0.3.1108:
  • TestSettings Dialog:
    RemoveAllItems-Button is disabled after loading empty Project.
  • TestSettings Dialog:
    when reloading a *.ctd file the Combo Box for the item selection needed for OPCItemProperties-Test Cases is filled correctly.
  • All Test cases:
    in the absence of items with appropriate access rights the test cases are skipped. However, all skipped test cases will be listed in the compliance test summary file and will also be published to the OPC Foundation.
  • LogicalTest:
    groups are added with ENGLISH ­ LCID to insure that VariantChangeType converts the strings "True" and "False".
  • LogicalTest >> CheckDataChange>>CheckActivateItems:
    is no longer setting a higher GroupUpdateRate than waiting for the resulting callbacks.
  • LogicalTest>> CheckValueConversion / CheckRangeBehavior:
    fixed wrong value generation if the server provides EU-Limits.
  • LogicalTest >> CheckDataTypes >> CheckValueConversionSyncRead:
    value generation for writing down to the server now respects the EU Limits.
  • LogicalTest >> CheckDataTypes >> CheckRangeBehaviourAsyncWrite:
    now checking the error in the function call and in the OnWriteComplete callback.
  • LogicalTest >> CheckUpdateRate::Case1:
    evaluate against RevisedUpdateRate now.
  • LogicalTest >> SyncWriteWithAllDataTypes:
    wrong value generation fixed using VariantChangeType
  • OPCServerObject >> IOPCBrowsAddressSpace >> BrowseOPCItemIDs::Case12 and Case13:
    now checking for name space architecture before executing the test, this solves an error on FLAT address space.
  • OPCServerObject interference with Stress Test:
    problem due to reference counting solved now.
  • OPCGroupObject>>IOPCAsyncIO2>>Cancel2::Case1:
    will be skipped if there are not Read/Write items available.
  • OPCGroupObject >> IOPCItemProperties >> LookupItemIDs::Case2 and Case3:
    the test is now executed with all properties even if only the PropIDs 1-6 are available.
